landmarks.anatomy: Superficial registration of addressed radiocarpal interval

modelIndicator.construction: APB superficial facet488 supports transfer of styloid/scaphoid/APL structural relation to the current palmar envelope. APB itself is not the location definition.
limitations: No observed skin crease, radial artery or pulsation; approximate structural model indicator.

landmarks.anatomy: Lateral cubital interval adjacent to distal biceps tendon

modelIndicator.construction: Observed distal tendon facet351 near distal humeral articulation. Authored cubital indicator at joint plane and 4mm lateral correspondence; no source skin crease or 90-degree flexion produced.
limitations: Elbow is extended; flexible crease/depression transferred as static structural indicator only.

landmarks.anatomy: APL tendon at distal radial forearm teaching groove

modelIndicator.construction: Two addressed native tendons delimit the radial teaching groove; native longitudinal wrist/cubital level yields 1.5/12. The surface marker registers that groove, not a ray-inferred anatomy.
limitations: No actual wrist crease or palpable depression; static groove is a model correspondence.

landmarks.anatomy: EPB tendon adjacent to APL groove

modelIndicator.construction: Two addressed native tendons delimit the radial teaching groove; native longitudinal wrist/cubital level yields 1.5/12. The surface marker registers that groove, not a ray-inferred anatomy.
limitations: No actual wrist crease or palpable depression; static groove is a model correspondence.

construction.anatomicalRelation: Verified LU5 cubital structural endpoint / LU9 radiocarpal structural endpoint; LU6 lies in their anterolateral interval. LU7 APL/EPB interval and LU8 radial-styloid context are retained independently. No radial artery/crease is observed.
construction.proximalStop: ring16 Y=1.002126932m just proximal to actual LU6; next ring17 at Y=1.010634899m has a pinched contour at angular index3. Stop rather than fill that defect.
construction.distalStop: ring1 Y=0.874507964m just distal to actual LU8; do not bridge the wrist-link seam to LU9.
construction.widthRule: AI anterior-to-radial-sector learning window: AT3 actual grid angular indices0..12. Deliberately broadens the source line to include separately verified LU7; no source defines this 108-degree display width.
construction.holes: retain the two native-envelope rejected-face holes as exclusion loops

handoff.operation: Validate frozen carrier bytes and context; treat consecutive loop vertex pairs including closing edge as barriers; flood face adjacency from seed1174. Preserve holes and component boundaries. Emit compact triangleIds/weights there, using shared carrier and overlay; no duplicate body mesh.
